ns2:section.sectionText: Scandinavian Brand Immersion: This 10-day study abroad course trip to Copenhagen, Denmark, and Stockholm, Sweden is designed to give advertising students a deep dive into the branding, advertising, and cultural strategies of major global companies based in Scandinavia, along with a broader exploration of Scandinavian design, architecture, and culture. Students will visit corporate headquarters of iconic companies like LEGO, IKEA, H&M, and UNIQLO to understand their global marketing strategies. Additionally, the itinerary includes visits to renowned cultural and design sites such as the Swedish Museum of Architecture and Design, Nyhavn, the Little Mermaid statue, and the Louisiana Museum of Modern Art. Travel will occur in May after the end of the Spring 2025 semester. Students must apply for and be accepted to the course. Applications available at https://www.studyabroad.illinois.edu/
